# Furnace King

> > Furnace King is a top-rated HVAC and home services contractor serving the Greater Toronto Area with furnace repair, AC installation, heat pumps, boiler services, plumbing, and emergency 24/7 support.

Furnace King operates across Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Vaughan, and surrounding GTA communities, offering comprehensive heating, cooling, and plumbing solutions with certified TSSA technicians and partnerships with leading brands like Trane and Bosch. The company emphasizes quality service guarantees, emergency response, and energy-efficient green solutions including rebate programs.
